about.title: From IT support to code
about.bio: Full Stack Developer and tenth-semester Systems Engineering student, specialized in scalable web applications with a C# (.NET) backend and a React frontend. I design and integrate REST APIs following Clean Architecture, applying patterns such as CQRS, Repository and Unit of Work with Entity Framework Core on PostgreSQL. I understand the software lifecycle, cloud deployment (AWS), web servers (IIS) and collaborative work with Scrum and GitFlow.
